$comment: ENGLISH profile 1.0.0 — the two-storey dictionary: measured grammar below (parser: spaCy 3.8.18 / en_core_web_md 3.8.0; measured accuracy 119/137 = 86.9% of dependency relations on the conformance fixture, flawless on its plain sentences; flaw clusters: parentheticals with hyphenated names, colon/dash clause lists, coordination labelling — full statement in docs/english-accuracy.md), labelled claims above (declared_claim edges only, claimant + basis required). Claims-class profile: no english graph is truth-class. Amendments are versioned + conformance re-run + gate verdict, as for CODE.

admission.notes: The four conditions, in words: (1) provable — NO for English as a whole: a sentence's grammar is checkable, a paragraph's meaning is not provable, so the profile does not claim the first condition. (2) logic structure — YES at the sentence level: dependency grammar (subject / predicate / object / modification) is formal structure, stated as rules by the parser's grammar. (3) connectivity — YES: sentences connect by containment, identity and claim structure. (4) extractable truths — SPLIT, and the split is the profile: grammar relations are extracted by a named statistical parser (spaCy 3.8.18, model en_core_web_md 3.8.0) and are therefore classed INFERENCE, never extracted_truth — a statistical parser's relation is a measurement with a measured error, not a rule-derived truth. MEASURED ACCURACY, printed here on the profile's face as the honesty rule requires: on the profile's conformance fixture (DESIGN.md section 1, seven dense technical sentences, every relation checked by eye) the parser scored 119/137 relations correct = 86.9%; the plain sentences of the same fixture scored at or near flawless (thesis sentence 8/8). Known flaw clusters, named as diagnostics: parentheticals attached to hyphenated names; colon/dash lists of clauses; coordination labelling. The full statement is docs/english-accuracy.md. Cross-sentence content (coreference, claim structure) fails condition (4) outright: no mechanical source exists for it today, so it enters only as DECLARED_CLAIM edges carrying a named claimant and a written basis. An english graph is claims-class as a whole, always: any graph containing an inference or declared_claim edge computes claims-bearing under the core section 4.3 rule, and english snapshots stamp graph_class claims. The label is the product's integrity; nothing in this profile may be presented as truth-class.

conformance.oracle: The English known-answer fixture: crates/codetopo-core/tests/english_profile_fixture.rs over crates/codetopo-core/tests/fixture-english/paragraph.snapshot.json — the DESIGN.md section 1 paragraph (7 sentences) as parsed by the pinned companion (spaCy 3.8.18 / en_core_web_md 3.8.0) and audited by eye in docs/english-accuracy.md. Expected: 75 nodes (1 document, 7 sentences, 22 predicates, 45 entities), 144 edges (132 grammar-class: 74 contains + 58 relations; 12 claim-class: 5 same-entity, 3 frames, 3 supports, 1 states-thesis-of). A change that moves a count moves the fixture, this oracle text, and docs/english-accuracy.md in the same PR.
conformance.tolerances: Exact for counts, sets, orders and class splits. The parser accuracy figure (119/137) is a measured property of the pinned parser on this fixture, re-measured by eye whenever the parser pin or the fixture changes — never carried forward unverified.

edge_kinds.gloss: Pure containment: a document contains its sentences; a sentence contains its predicates and entities
edge_kinds.name: contains

edge_kinds.gloss: An entity is the subject of a predicate (spaCy nsubj / nsubjpass / csubj); the edge carries the exact spaCy relation in its dep attr
edge_kinds.name: subject-of

edge_kinds.gloss: An entity is the object of a predicate (spaCy dobj, or pobj under a preposition the predicate governs; the preposition rides in the via attr)
edge_kinds.name: object-of

edge_kinds.gloss: An entity is the complement of a predicate (spaCy attr — the copula's complement: 'our reason is the edges')
edge_kinds.name: complement-of

edge_kinds.gloss: An entity modifies another entity or a predicate through a prepositional or nominal modifier (spaCy pobj under a noun, nmod); the preposition rides in the via attr when present
edge_kinds.name: modifier-of

edge_kinds.gloss: A predicate heads a subordinate or relative clause of another predicate or of an entity (spaCy relcl / acl / advcl / ccomp / xcomp / parataxis); the exact relation rides in the dep attr
edge_kinds.name: clause-of

edge_kinds.gloss: An entity stands in apposition to another entity (spaCy appos)
edge_kinds.name: appositive-of

edge_kinds.gloss: An entity or predicate is coordinated with another (spaCy conj) — one item of an and/or list
edge_kinds.name: coordinated-with

edge_kinds.gloss: Two mentions are the same entity (coreference: a pronoun, a definite reference, a repeated noun phrase). Interpretation, never parser output: a reading agent declares it, naming itself in claimant and its grounds in basis. Identity is directionless, so the kind is symmetric: path queries traverse it both ways
edge_kinds.name: same-entity

edge_kinds.gloss: A sentence frames the problem another sentence answers or states. A reading agent's claim: claimant and basis are required
edge_kinds.name: frames

edge_kinds.gloss: A sentence supports another sentence — evidence, elaboration, a parallel case. A reading agent's claim: claimant and basis are required
edge_kinds.name: supports

edge_kinds.gloss: A sentence states the thesis of the whole document. A reading agent's claim: claimant and basis are required
edge_kinds.name: states-thesis-of

id_grammar.package_rule: An english graph has one document; sentence ids are s1..sN in reading order; a sentence's predicates are v<token index> and its entities e<chunk index>, both 0-based as the parser enumerates them. The conformance fixture uses the bare document id para with sentence ids s1..s7 at top level — the same grammar with the document prefix elided, as the spike emitted it.

location.ordering: file, then the 1-based line at which the sentence starts in the source text

node_kinds.gloss: A whole text under analysis (a paragraph, a section, a document) — the containment root
node_kinds.name: document

node_kinds.gloss: One sentence of the document, as segmented by the parser
node_kinds.name: sentence

node_kinds.gloss: A verb heading a clause — the sentence's action (attrs carry the lemma as verb, and negated)
node_kinds.name: predicate

node_kinds.gloss: A noun phrase — a thing the text talks about (attrs carry chunk_root and the chunk root's dependency relation)
node_kinds.name: entity

node_kinds.gloss: A reference outside the document (named, not graphed) — the boundary kind, declared for completeness; companion output does not emit it
node_kinds.name: external

title: ENGLISH — document grammar (measured) under labelled claims

well_formedness.name: containment_forest
well_formedness.rule: Containment forms a forest rooted at the document: every sentence, predicate and entity has exactly one container.

well_formedness.name: provenance_required
well_formedness.rule: A claim edge (a declared_claim kind: same-entity, frames, supports, states-thesis-of) without a claimant or without a basis is not a claim, it is a smuggled assertion — it is refused wherever edges are admitted, and a graph carrying one mislabels itself.

well_formedness.name: attribute_allow_list
well_formedness.rule: No edge kind may carry attributes outside its declared row.

well_formedness.name: no_unlabelled_interpretation
well_formedness.rule: The companion (tools/english-ingest) emits grammar kinds only; any edge of a claim kind in an english graph was placed by a reading agent and must carry that agent's claimant and basis. A claim kind without them violates provenance_required; a grammar kind emitted by anything but the named parser violates the accuracy statement's terms.
